g.text: A question for the agent, answered in the document.
here is approval handled, and how does the reason get back to the model?
Approval lives in `leela/agent/hitl.py`. The gate returns an `Ask` rather than a
bool, which is what lets the reason a person gives travel back to the model instead
of being flattened to "denied" — `Ask.__bool__` is falsy when refused, so both
